name: DecomposeBySubdomain
summary: Draws a service around one subdomain of the business as domain-driven design identifies them, so that the boundary follows the model rather than what the organisation happens to do.

roles.name: DecomposeBySubdomain
roles.summary: The service drawn around one subdomain, which the work classifies after Evans as core, supporting or generic. It usually lands on the same boundary a business capability would, and it is not the same claim: this one says the boundary follows the model, so a change to the model of a second subdomain should not reach here.
